title: The Hermes Librarian
tagline: LOCAL INSPECTABLE MEMORY FOR HERMES AGENT
valueStatement: Vector recall and a knowledge graph in one Postgres — the model can find what you said, and you can see the walk.
architectureHighlight: Two stores, one semantic topology. Apache AGE keeps the session flower; Postgres holds the shared noun manifold with ordered mentions. One bounded walker scores both prefetch and /search.
description: An unofficial `hybrid-age` MemoryProvider for Hermes Agent. Conversations land as turns, AGE keeps the session flower (`Session` / `Turn` / `NEXT`), and Postgres holds a shared noun manifold with ordered `mentions`. Prefetch injects that walk into the prompt. Fountain is an optional 3D Garden on loopback — recall works with the pane closed. It does not replace `MEMORY.md` / `USER.md`.
role: Sole designer & engineer (schema, walker, provider, pane)
pitch: Local, inspectable memory for Hermes Agent — vector recall and a knowledge graph in one Postgres, so the model can find what you said and you can see the walk.
challenge: Agent memory is usually a vector dump or a hidden graph. Hubs collapse into a few Title-Case 'Concepts,' sessions leak into each other, and you cannot tell whether injection came from this chat or someone else's nouns. I needed durable local recall that grows with real conversation, stays inspectable, and does not pretend to be a hosted brain.
development: Two stores, one semantic topology. Apache AGE (PG17) is episodic only — this session, this turn, order in time. Postgres is the manifold: global `noun` rows, per-turn passports on `memory_chunk_nodes`, bivalent `semantic_edge` poles (`mentions` = co-occurrence, not theme). ANN entry is `conversations.embedding` (Ollama `nomic-embed-text`, 768-d). One bounded walker scores both prefetch and `/search`: `score = (0.4·sim + 0.4·align·provenance + 0.2·decay) × (magnitude / 8)`. Fountain docks nouns onto their turns and draws teal mention threads. Loopback only (`127.0.0.1:5450` / `:7890`). MIT. Alpha.
outcome: Shipped as `hermes-memory` on GitHub (PR #67): V9 schema, mention-order extractor, drain that stops conversation `Concept`/`ABOUT`, passport isolation tests, Garden-only pane. A real chat seeds the first graph; verify uses synthetics on purpose. Live DB migrate remains an ops step so nouns appear in production memory.

specs.title: One topology
specs.description: Episodic flower in AGE; semantic switches in SQL. No dual Concept/ABOUT + noun graph for the same labels.

specs.title: Shared nouns, private passports
specs.description: `noun.label` is global; two sessions can mention Postgres; they do not share the walk's provenance.

specs.title: Same score everywhere
specs.description: Prefetch, `/search`, and the pane use one 7-tuple beam; no second ranking in the UI.

specs.title: Recall without the spectacle
specs.description: Fountain is optional grammar. Vector + graph injection works if you never open the pane.
